hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results. The text explicitly stated Beatrice of Castile was the mother ('second wife Beatrice of Castile'), but the Planner hallucinated that she was the paternal grandmother. Had the Planner verified this relationship against the raw text before concluding, the error would have been caught.
